instruction: Fix `flatten` so it recursively flattens arbitrarily nested lists, not just a single level.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops.py b/seqops.py
--- a/seqops.py
+++ b/seqops.py
@@ -57,7 +57,13 @@
 
 def flatten(nested):
     """Flatten a nested list of lists into a single list."""
-    return [item for sublist in nested for item in sublist]
+    out = []
+    for item in nested:
+        if isinstance(item, list):
+            out.extend(flatten(item))
+        else:
+            out.append(item)
+    return out
